newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sees wider trade gap in second half 1997.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sees wider trade gap in second half 1997.

text.p: Vietnam is targetting its second-half 1997 exports at $5.1 billion and estimating its imports for the period at $6.8 billion, a senior Trade Ministry official said on Thursday.
That would give a trade gap of $1.7 billion, up from the first-half deficit of $1.43 billion reported by the General Statistics Office last week.
The official said that the targetted figure for second-half exports was 24 percent higher than in the same period of last year.
Last year Vietnam posted a record trade deficit of $4.0 billion, equivalent to about 17 percent of its gross domestic product (GDP).
